inputs.text: Canada’s tightening of immigration and asylum rules under Bill C-12, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026, risks making people seeking safety pay for a political choice to securitize migration. Nigerians and others facing these rules are already navigating unequal power and precarious circumstances; harsher borders deepen that vulnerability instead of protecting people. This is an institutional failure that demands a rights-centered response.
